subject: Parameters
notes: kb/Work PB1112 leg 5, fixed by kb/Work PB1166 (a38622ede) and re-probed on this tree (wave 73 E). Rule (cite.py --check 14.8.2.2 "shall be an alphanumeric group item or an elementary item of category alphanumeric" -> OK 14.8.2.2 1); 14.8.2.1 NOTE "A bit group or national group is treated as an elementary item" -> OK). The group arms ask IsCategoryAlphanumeric and route a bit/national group through AsIfElementaryGroupMismatch before the alphanumeric-group arms. Measured with the note's probes: pe, pf, pk, pl, pg / pg2 -> all COBOL1688. kb/Work PB546's byte half (registrar 14b: 'the same number or a smaller number of bytes' measured on positions) re-probed on the w1070 A build: an 8-byte alphanumeric group holding N(2) + X(4) binds into an 8-byte and a 6-byte group formal over INVOKE and the callee reads WXYZ / WX at bytes 5-8 / 5-6, i.e. the group is measured in bytes. retired-witness: src/Cobol.Net.Compiler/Oo/OoConformance.cs#DescriptionMismatch (kb/Work PB3101 (wave 1082): the DataItem comparator family is deleted (OoConformance.DescriptionMismatch, StrongTypeMismatch, AsIfElementaryGroupMismatch, IsCategoryAlphanumeric, PictureClauseIdentity.Mismatch, ObjectRefDescriptor.SameDescriptionAs); every activation and pair-mode question describes its items through ActivationDescriptions and asks ActivationRelations (CallArgumentViolation / CallReturningViolation / MatchViolation / SignatureDifference), the PICTURE identity entering through PictureClauseIdentity.Key) retired-witness: src/Cobol.Net.Compiler/Oo/OoConformance.cs#IsCategoryAlphanumeric (kb/Work PB3101 (wave 1082): the DataItem comparator family is deleted (OoConformance.DescriptionMismatch, StrongTypeMismatch, AsIfElementaryGroupMismatch, IsCategoryAlphanumeric, PictureClauseIdentity.Mismatch, ObjectRefDescriptor.SameDescriptionAs); every activation and pair-mode question describes its items through ActivationDescriptions and asks ActivationRelations (CallArgumentViolation / CallReturningViolation / MatchViolation / SignatureDifference), the PICTURE identity entering through PictureClauseIdentity.Key)
